title: Implement Mutex API dual-runtime client
description:
## Implementation

After Mutex API Gherkin and the infrastructure prototype: Python + Rust client for acquire/renew/release/inspect, selected when the Mutex API is configured. Strongest-available provider still degrades to MQTT then Git.

## Acceptance

Gherkin green on both runtimes. Unconfigured Mutex API does not break Git-only or MQTT-only installs.
